    Split-basic full-corner reduction #

    This file constructs a full idempotent corner of a finite-dimensional algebra over an algebraically closed field and equips that corner with a chosen split-basic presentation. The construction is characteristic-free: it uses Wedderburn--Artin for the semisimple quotient, lifting of orthogonal idempotents through the nilpotent Jacobson radical, and the first isomorphism theorem for the selected corner.

    source
    structure EFiniteCharacterizations.SplitBasicIdempotents {k : Type u} [Field k] {A : Type v} [Ring A] [Algebra k A] {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :
    Type (max (max u u_1) v)

    Chosen split-basic idempotents: a complete orthogonal family whose images identify the semisimple quotient with the coordinate idempotents of k^ι. This is the presentation on which the ordinary Cartan matrix is computed.

    • idempotent : ι → A

      Chosen primitive idempotent lifts.

    • complete : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents self.idempotent
    • quotientEquiv : (A ⧸ Ring.jacobson A) ≃ₐ[k] ι → k
    • quotientEquiv_mk_idempotent (i j : ι) : self.quotientEquiv ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ring.jacobson A)) (self.idempotent i)) j = if i = j then 1 else 0

                            structure EFiniteCharacterizations.BasicIdempotentData (k : Type u) [Field k] (A : Type v) [Ring A] [Algebra k A] :
                            Type (max u v)

                            Wedderburn--Artin data lifted from the semisimple quotient: one orthogonal idempotent above a rank-one diagonal matrix unit in each simple block. Their sum is full.
